guide.title: The steps

assisted.1: Press PLAY: {{client}} opens and builds your ROM next to the patch.
assisted.2: Start your emulator and load that ROM.
assisted.3: Link the emulator to the client as the official tutorial explains (Lua script, SNI…).
assisted.4: If the client asks for the server, enter {{address}} and the slot {{slot}}.
assisted.4NoSlot: If the client asks for the server, enter {{address}}, then your slot name.

guided.1: Install and set up the game with the official tutorial.
guided.2: In the game or its client, connect to {{address}}.
guided.3NoSlot: Enter your slot name, the one in your YAML, when the client asks for it.
guided.4: The Text Client lets you follow the game and ask for hints.
